reading: The sketch lays out a cinema seat-selection page: a top progress stepper, a large hall panel containing a curved 'SCREEN' indicator with label, a lettered row-guide column, a 12x11 seat grid with an aisle gap and a colour legend, plus a right-hand booking-summary card with poster, showtime details, selected-seat chips, price breakdown, a countdown notice and a continue button. Typed notes give exact colours, sizes and content for every piece, which were followed over the raw ink shapes.
